facts: A commercial applicator license is required for use of any pesticide as a service for which compensation is received, including home pest control
Commercial Applicator—Master is required for one individual within each company, organization, branch office or agency
Commercial Applicator—Operator is the minimum for technicians and is valid only while the employer has at least one licensed master applicator
Firm license $300, required of all custom applicator companies other than sole proprietors with no other employees; proof of insurance and a Commercial Master applicator required
Structural categories: 7A Structural General Pest Control, 7E Biting Fly & Other Arthropod Vectors (Ticks), 7F Termite Pests
Commercial licenses run 3 years; Master needs 9 recertification credits, Operator 6
Commercial applicator licenses are company-affiliated and void when the licensee leaves the company
BPC publishes a public Licensed Commercial Applicators directory

browntail_moth.why: Maine-specific pest with a state winter web survey and a Maine CDC health advisory; falls in category 7E
